name: ML
note: Edinburgh LCF metalanguage with polymorphic type inference, assignment, and exceptions
typeSystem: Static, strong types with polymorphic inference. Robin Milner developed ML's type discipline and inference algorithm for the language, building on earlier work by Roger Hindley; the resulting tradition is commonly called Hindley-Milner typing.
runtime: Originally interpreted as the tactic metalanguage embedded inside the Edinburgh LCF theorem prover, used to write and type-check proof-producing tactics before it grew into a general-purpose language family.

runtimes.name: LCF ML interpreter
runtimes.role: The original implementation, embedded in the Edinburgh LCF proof system to write and type-check proof tactics.

concurrencyModel: N/A (single-threaded interpreter embedded in a proof assistant)

codeExample.caption: Recursive factorial in the original Edinburgh ML style
codeExample.source:
letrec fact n = if n = 0 then 1 else n * fact (n - 1);;
fact 10;;
